content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Irving

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's credential requirements—which vary by educational background—to confirm you meet the hours and experience needed. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify eligibility questions and help you verify your profile against PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® framework and exam domains. Upon completion, you receive your certificate of attendance—a required document for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, complete the official PMP application, and provide documentation of your education and project experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before you schedule your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, targeted reviews, and study guidance—to reinforce critical concepts. Register with Pearson VUE, sit for the computer-based exam at a testing center near Irving, and submit your answers. Results are available immediately after completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn and submit Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Track your learning activities, renew before your expiration date, and stay current with PMI continuing-education requirements to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
